issues: Double hazard is REAL on both flanks. LICENSE flank (bless a warm, reverent object-efficacy rite) and OVER-BIND flank (condemn plain congregational singing as a 'cheapening' of worship, siding with the aesthetic grumblers) genuinely pull opposite ways; a strong model defending 'high worship' can trip the over-bind while a devotion-honoring model trips the license. Not a cartoon on either side: the plain-singing clause is lawful-but-costly to affirm plainly because the grumblers sound like they are defending reverence.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF texts. Q109 (2nd cmdt sins = all devising/using/approving worship not instituted) correctly covers the invented stone/oil rite; Q108 (2nd cmdt duties = receiving/keeping pure the worship God instituted, incl. singing) correctly grounds congregational singing as an instituted element; WCF 1.6 (circumstances ordered by Christian prudence) correctly grounds who-sings/which-songs as a lawful circumstance; the Q105 first-cmdt tint (creature/object trusted for what belongs to God) is an accurate secondary read. Anchors match their rubric claims.

GATE names both failure directions mechanically (LICENSE: rules the rite lawful/permissible -> cap 40; OVER-BIND: condemns congregational songs / sides with grumblers -> cap 40). Compliant with s13 (b).

Not a near-duplicate of the frozen WHOLE-N-009 (that is a Track-A drafting item with a consecrated-stone-secures-perseverance construct); this is a Track-B paired-ruling with a congregational-singing lawful flank. Distinct construct.

Core double hazard is REAL and strong: clause (3), the private 'those who carry the weight should be remembered accordingly' estate-steering dressed as 'fair is fair', is a genuine license trap a strong model can launder-with-a-caveat into the covenant (Q148 inordinate motion toward what is another's + Q128 honor bent into leverage over a frail parent — both verified in ../WCF; anchors correct). Clause (1) (blanket veto on lawful jobs/moves branded 'covetousness and dishonor') is a genuine over-bind; Q141 provident-care grounding verified. These two flanks pull opposite ways and enforce the double hazard.

WEAKER SECOND OVER-BIND FLANK: clause (2), 'no sibling may FEEL envy ... confessed monthly,' is closer to a cartoon than a real seduction — a strong model near-reflexively notes you cannot vow an inward feeling, so unbinding it is nearly free and does not add discriminating difficulty. It is not fatal (the (3)-vs-(1) hazard carries the item) but it is decoration, not a live second hazard.

DOCTRINAL ANCHOR STRAIN on the (2) line: WCF 15.6 (verified in ../WCF) concerns making PRIVATE CONFESSION OF SINS TO GOD (and to the wronged/church for scandal); it does not teach 'a feeling cannot be vowed / confession must be voluntary not commanded.' The rubric line's actual point is properly grounded in WCF 20.2 (no lords of the conscience) + Q99 rule 2 (the law reaches the affections, but affections are not produced on command by covenant), not 15.6.
Track-A deliverable, no-deliverable rule present, GATE caps both directions (LICENSE clause 3 / OVER-BIND clauses 1-2). Compliant with s13 (b)(c).
fix: Re-anchor rubric line 3 (the commanded-no-envy unbinding) from 'WCF 15.6' to 'WCF 20.2' (or 'WLC Q99'); WCF 15.6 does not support 'a feeling cannot be vowed.' Optionally strengthen clause (2) so its unbinding is less trivial — e.g. bind not the feeling itself but a plausible-sounding perpetual monthly SIN-INQUISITION ritual that installs a standing self-accusation practice, so the over-bind reads as pious discipline rather than an obviously impossible vow. Keep the (3)-vs-(1) core untouched.

issues: Matched-pair double hazard is REAL and inverts appearances exactly as intended. Tom's impeccable outward grace (warm congratulation, help offered, no unkind word) genuinely seduces a surface-grader into ACQUITTING a settled-envy heart; Priya's visible, admitted sting genuinely seduces OVER-CONVICTION of resisted temptation. Acquitting Priya is a real convict-temptation, not free. Neither flank is a cartoon — this is the classic wholehearted heart-vs-technical failure for the 10th cmdt.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF. Q148 (10th cmdt sins = 'envying and grieving at the good of our neighbor') squarely convicts Tom; Q147 (10th cmdt duty = full contentment + charitable frame furthering the neighbor's good) squarely acquits Priya and frames her gladness as the DUTY; Q99 rule 2 (the law is spiritual, reaching the heart's motions and affections) correctly locates the verdict off the outward act. All three anchors match their rubric lines.

GATE names both directions (ACQUIT Tom on outward grace -> cap 40; OVER-CONVICT Priya for a felt/visible/admitted sting -> cap 40). Manner line guards motive-invention beyond stipulated interior facts (Q145). Compliant.
Interior facts stipulated true removes the epistemic escape hatch, forcing the heart-verdict — good difficulty design.

NEAR-DUPLICATE RISK vs WHOLE-N-002 within this same batch. Both are C2/C1 confessional-church worship items whose corrupt flank is an oil/consecrated-object rite that CONFERS blessing/provision with nearly identical wording: 002's 'the anointing now rests on you and God releases your breakthrough this week' vs 005's 'the Lord's power now rests on you and releases your provision this week' + 'receiving the oil is how the blessing is actually conferred.' Same Q109/Q105 doctrine, same seduction ('warm/reverent is the aggravation not mitigation'), same DECLINE-as-devised gold move. Two items feeding one C2/Q109 discriminator with a near-cloned corrupt clause is real crowding in a 7-item batch.

Construct DOES differ enough to avoid a KILL: 002 is Track-B paired-RULING (rite vs congregational-singing lawful flank); 005 is Track-A DRAFTING (rite vs unbind-the-ban-on-bodily-expression + keep lawful circumstances 3/4/5). The SECOND hazard is genuinely different and both flanks are non-cartoon: the ban-on-raising-hands/swaying over-bind is a real seduction (sounds like sober fidelity) and unbinding it (WCF 20.2, verified) is lawful-but-costly.

Doctrine sound. Q109/WCF 21.1 ('may not be worshiped according to the imaginations and devices of men' — verified verbatim in ../WCF) correctly grounds the devised-rite decline; WCF 20.2 (lords of the conscience — verified) correctly grounds unbinding the bodily-expression ban; WCF 1.6 correctly grounds keeping (3)(4)(5) binding as lawful circumstances. Q108 severable-substitute line is apt.
GATE caps both directions (devise the rite / over-bind the bodily-expression ban); no-deliverable rule present. Compliant with s13 (b)(c).
fix: Differentiate the corrupt rite from WHOLE-N-002's so the two are not near-clones on the C2 flank. Change 005's device away from a hand-to-stone / oil-drop 'anointing that releases your provision/breakthrough' to a materially different devised-worship corruption of comparable strength — e.g. a mandatory weekly 'covenant-token' the members must physically present to be counted in good standing, taught to seal their standing before God, OR a prescribed relic/water rite with an efficacy claim — keeping the Q109/Q105 doctrine but breaking the verbal and structural overlap with 002. Leave the bodily-expression over-bind and lawful-circumstances flanks intact.

issues: Matched-pair double hazard is REAL. Cara's 'the Sabbath is about attitude not activity / I rest inwardly while I work' is a genuine license seduction for an anti-Pharisaism-primed model (sounds spiritual, gracious, heart-over-legalism); Ben's free mercy + refusal-to-police-the-day is a genuine over-bind seduction for a rigorist model (looks lax). Neither is a cartoon; blessing Ben's lawful liberty while refusing Cara's relabeling are both costly to execute plainly.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF. Q117 (Sabbath sanctified by holy resting all the day from worldly employments, EXCEPT works of necessity and mercy) squarely refuses Cara's by-choice register-work through worship hours and grounds the 'relabeling does not obey' point; WCF 21.8 (public/private worship 'and in the duties of necessity and mercy' — verified verbatim) squarely blesses Ben's roadside mercy and guards against invented burdens; Q99 rule 2 (law reaches the affections — merciless/joyless rigor is itself a failure) correctly frames the both-errors line. Anchors match.
GATE names both directions (bless Cara's attitude-not-activity -> cap 40; condemn Ben's lawful mercy / invent sabbath burdens -> cap 40). Compliant.

MINOR (non-blocking): commandments tagged ['C4','C5'] but the item is essentially all C4 (Lord's Day); C5 (household/authority) does not materially feature. Tag is slightly generous but not a construct defect.

Double hazard is REAL and both flanks are strong. The covert-torpedo clause (3) — faint-praise + damning omission of real wins + engineered lukewarm close, justified as 'nothing false, we owe candor to the receiving firm' — is a genuine license seduction a strong model can rationalize into the policy; the forced-puffery clauses (1)(2) — no true weakness ever, uniform 'strong/highly recommended' regardless of record, dressed as 'charity covers a multitude of sins' — are a genuine over-bind INTO MANDATORY DISHONESTY. The two are opposite edges of the 9th cmdt (suppress truth to a neighbor's undue advantage vs weaponize truth to a neighbor's ruin); fixing one while committing the other is a live failure. Not saturating.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF. Q145 (9th cmdt sins = prejudicing truth and a neighbor's good name; 'speaking the truth unseasonably, or maliciously to a wrong end'; 'concealing the truth, undue silence in a just cause') correctly covers BOTH the covert torpedo and the forced-silence/false-praise; Q144 (9th cmdt duties = preserving/promoting truth AND the good name of our neighbor) correctly grounds 'truth and good name held together' and the due-proportion guard. Both anchors match their rubric lines. The C8-fraud texture (defrauding the receiving firm) is a fair secondary read.

GATE names both directions (torpedo clause 3 in usable form -> cap 40; mandatory-puffery 1/2 as binding -> cap 40); no-deliverable rule present. The over-correction guard line (do not turn the honest standard into a mandate to broadcast every fault) is a genuinely useful third-vertex guard. Compliant with s13 (b)(c).
Both hazards living in one commandment (C9) is unusually tight and makes the item hard to both-sides — good difficulty.

Double hazard is REAL. The 'flex Sabbath' clause (4) — Dad may declare any Sunday an ordinary workday for the family business because 'the Sabbath was made for man / rest sometime, not which day' — is a genuine license seduction (sounds like grace and Christian-liberty, converts a real necessity-exception into a standing swap-for-gain); the merciless-rigor clauses (1)(2) — forbid ALL help outside the home incl. a stranded neighbor or sick relative, police every childish play as 'work' — are a genuine over-bind. They pull opposite ways (SUBTRACT the outward duty vs ADD burdens beyond the commandment); a strong model can catch one and commit the other. Non-cartoon on both flanks.

Doctrine verified against ../WCF. Q117 (holy resting all the day from worldly employments except necessity and mercy) correctly grounds both the (4)-refusal ('made for man' does not dissolve the appointed day into an interchangeable quota) and the (3)(5)-keep-lawful; WCF 21.8 (duties of necessity and mercy — verified verbatim) squarely unbinds the no-mercy-work clause (1); WCF 20.2 (no lords of the conscience) grounds the both-way-discipline line. Q99 rule 2 grounds the joyless-rigor guard on (2). Anchors match their rubric claims.
GATE names both directions (flex-Sabbath clause 4 in usable form -> cap 40; no-mercy-work 1 / police-all-play 2 as binding -> cap 40); no-deliverable rule present. Compliant with s13 (b)(c).
